objective: Public visual-model TensorRT deployment, integrated bounded dataflow and reproducible B1 handoff before user-led optimization

architecture.inference: In-process TensorRT for every deployed visual neural network
architecture.application: Reuse the existing application and pinned upstream components; scene-specific adapters only
architecture.reference: PyTorch, ONNX Runtime or OpenCV may be used as explicit validation references, never a silent production inference fallback
architecture.sensor_depth: D435i native depth and RealSense SDK alignment; TensorRT requirement applies to deployed visual neural networks

modules.capability: Native D435i metric depth registered to RGB, with invalid masks, timestamps and distance-gate validation
Person/object boxes, classes, scores and instance masks
Public model body/hand keypoints with explicit topology, confidence and coordinate semantics
Face boxes, confidence and five landmarks
Head orientation with documented axes and units
Gaze direction with documented axes and units
Face alignment, embedding, registered identity matching and unknown result
Person appearance features and bounded target association
Object features and measured association cases, not a claim of universal instance recognition
The public model's documented expression scores
Wave greeting and stationary open-palm full-turn cancellation

gates.name: Pinned sources, weights, license and interface contracts
gates.scope: Selected public artifacts, versions, declared upstream licenses and IO/prepost semantics inspected; proprietary topology/classes remain explicitly deferred.

gates.name: Native RGBD capture/alignment and whole-body pose conversion/reference feasibility
Per-model TensorRT execution and reference parity
Shared frame provenance, ROI transforms, distance gates and target association
gates.scope: Frozen public replay, source/expiry/distance invalidation probes and SDK lifecycle evidence; real crossing/occlusion/distance accuracy is not asserted.

gates.name: Bounded resource ownership, stale data, cancellation and recovery
gates.scope: Controlled lifecycle/stale-data/cancellation/recovery probes pass. R1 20-minute replay and 10-minute live windows complete; measured resource drift, delayed exit and thermal transitions retained for follow-up. No claim of R2 long soak, zero leaks or industrial endurance.

gates.name: Fixed-input and live-camera functional acceptance with explicit coverage
gates.scope: Actual-model fixed-observation wave-to-4B/TTS and stationary-palm cancellation pass. Latest-frame realtime motion replay still misses; live wave and broader person/gesture accuracy remain open. Fixed-observation backpressure is not a production fix.

gates.name: Frozen B1 module/pipeline/coexistence measurements and raw evidence
gates.scope: Neural module paths/engines/inputs unchanged; inherit original isolated measurements. R2 pipeline measured separately. 28 observer deadline misses retained, with bounded scope and no performance improvement claim.

gates.name: Startup, architecture, diagnostics and user profiling handoff
gates.scope: R2 runtime restored in source-hidden loopback-only same-host checkout; default B1 startup, file response and Firefox camera/model panel verified. Startup/config/rollback and first reproducible profiling steps documented. Functional gate B1.5 remains open; no user learning or optimization completion asserted.

contract_requirements: Repository commit, weight checksum and license scope
Input names, shapes, dtype, color, normalization and crop/resize transform
Output topology, confidence semantics, coordinate frame, units and invalid markers
Frame-group id, source epoch, timestamps, target id and expiry
Trigger/exit conditions, rates, maximum targets, queues and inference instances
Reference-parity method, functional fixtures and acceptance thresholds fixed before measurement
deferred_contracts: Original proprietary 70/52 keypoint indexing and exact output equivalence
The complete original ten-class gesture classifier
deferred_scope: Neural stereo depth; native D435i depth is required instead
completion_rule: Every locked in-scope module and gate requires inspected real evidence; interfaces, empty placeholders or server startup alone do not prove completion. Handoff B1 then wait for user-led optimization.
measurement_rule: Preserve B0; measure actual performance without promising all models at 30 FPS. Separate model changes from same-model optimization, reference validation from production inference, and fixed/public replay from real-person quality qualification.

scope_updates.source: Explicit user instruction: use native RealSense depth, no neural depth inference; finish remaining modules
scope_updates.effect: D435i SDK depth/alignment replaces neural-stereo depth in required B1 acceptance. Neural stereo artifacts retained only as deferred experimental evidence.

auxiliary_models.capability: 35-point face landmarks needed to crop both eyes for the published OMZ gaze cascade
